AT03: Concordia Station keeps Australian Western time (UTC+8), unlike other Antarctic stations; TBB maps it to Australia/Perth.
AT28: Vostok Station keeps its own UTC+5 (Antarctica/Vostok).
MMCS: Ciudad Juarez follows US Mountain time with US daylight saving (America/Ciudad_Juarez since tzdb 2022g), unlike the rest of Mexico.
NTGJ: The Gambier Islands keep UTC-9 (Pacific/Gambier), an hour behind Tahiti.
PCIS: Kanton in the Phoenix Islands keeps UTC+13 (Pacific/Kanton).
PMDY: Midway Atoll keeps Samoa time, UTC-11 (Pacific/Midway); the US Minor Outlying Islands straddle the date line.
PWAK: Wake Island keeps UTC+12 (Pacific/Wake); the US Minor Outlying Islands straddle the date line.
SBFN: Fernando de Noronha keeps UTC-2 (America/Noronha), an hour ahead of mainland north-east Brazil.
SCIP: Easter Island keeps UTC-6 with Chilean daylight saving (Pacific/Easter).
YECL: Eucla keeps the unofficial Central Western time, UTC+8:45 (Australia/Eucla).
YLHI: Lord Howe Island keeps UTC+10:30 with a half-hour daylight saving shift (Australia/Lord_Howe).
